calc: {%- comment -%} Sale-day free gifts (Claude, Nov 21 2026). Counts what in the cart qualifies for the sale-day gifts and how many of each gift are already in it. Used by snippets/tme-sale-gifts and sections/tme-sale-gifts. book = our own manga/light novels, Vol 1 bundles and complete sets (same rule as the Lucky Pack), before discounts. spent = everything except free gifts and the Share the Love Fund, before discounts. Gifts: 55000797446462 Small Business Saturday handmade goodie, 55000797511998 Cyber Monday mystery gift. {%- endcomment -%} {%- liquid assign sg_book = 0 assign sg_spent = 0 assign sg_a_qty = 0 assign sg_a_key = '' assign sg_b_qty = 0 assign sg_b_key = '' for item in cart.items if item.variant_id == 55000797446462 assign sg_a_qty = sg_a_qty | plus: item.quantity if sg_a_key == '' assign sg_a_key = item.key endif continue endif if item.variant_id == 55000797511998 assign sg_b_qty = sg_b_qty | plus: item.quantity if sg_b_key == '' assign sg_b_key = item.key endif continue endif if item.product.tags contains 'Free Gift' or item.product.type == 'Share the Love Fund' continue endif assign sg_spent = sg_spent | plus: item.original_line_price assign sg_ok = false unless item.product.tags contains 'Shopify Collective' if item.product.type == 'Manga' or item.product.type == 'Light Novel' assign sg_ok = true endif endunless for c in item.product.collections if c.handle == 'vol-1-bundle-deals' or c.handle == 'complete-series-sets' assign sg_ok = true endif endfor if sg_ok assign sg_book = sg_book | plus: item.original_line_price endif endfor -%}
